subject: Trident PoC: request for additional credits, extension, and promotional allowance
messages:
From: Ethan Zhao <e.zhao@trident.ai>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial extension + additional credits for Trident PoC

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the quick support during our PoC. We hit a couple of unexpected delays on the integration side (third-party data transformer issues) which pushed our evaluation window out by roughly two weeks. Because of that, we don’t have enough usage left in the current trial to validate latency/cost under our expected production load.

Can Redwood provide the following as a one-time concession so we can finish the PoC and move to a purchasing conversation?
- Top-up of 200,000 generation tokens of free credit (applied to the PoC project)
- 30-day trial extension from current trial expiry (originally May 2)
- A promotional discount on the first month of committed capacity (20% off) if we convert to a 6-month minimum commitment within 30 days of PoC close

We’d like to wrap the PoC by mid-May. If there’s a standard form or MA that covers this, please point me to it. I’ve attached the current usage extract and the PoC timeline.

Appreciate the help — Ethan

Attachments: Trident_PoC_usage_Q1.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Zhao <e.zhao@trident.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + additional credits for Trident PoC

Ethan — thanks for the clear summary and the usage file. I’m sorry to hear about the transformer delays. We want to make it straightforward for you to complete validation.

I can offer to escalate for an exception. Proposed concession for review:
- 200k generation tokens top-up applied to the existing PoC project ID
- 30-day trial extension (new expiry: 2027-06-01)
- Promotional first-month discount: 15% off for a 6-month commit (we may need exec approval for anything >15%)

Ben and Marissa — looping you in to confirm whether we can approve the 200k + 30-day extension at SDR/AE level, and whether the 15% promo can be pushed to 20% with exec signoff. Trident is asking for 20% if they commit to 6 months; they are a strategic mid-market target in our data-processing vertical.

Ethan — I’ll come back with a concrete approval path and timeline by EOD tomorrow. If it helps, we can set a short call with our CS engineer to reduce friction on their side while we finalize approvals.

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding Trident’s ask and Ava’s note. High level:
- Trident has been responsive and technically engaged; this is likely to convert to a paid commit if we get them to full validation.
- Current ask: 200k token top-up, 30-day extension, 20% promo on first month for 6-mo commit. Ava recommends approving 15% at AE level and escalating the extra 5% request.

I’ve sketched projected margin impact below (very conservative):
- 200k generation tokens ~ $1,600 equivalent list cost in our hosting burn for this proof (depends on model/seq)
- 20% first-month discount on a $12k/month projected first-month invoice = $2.4k revenue concession
- Total near-term revenue impact ~ $4k with upside of a multi-month committed contract

Recommendation: approve token top-up and extension immediately (time-sensitive), and conditionally approve a 20% promotional concession but require a 6-mo minimum and a signed MA. If you want to cap the free tokens to 150k we could do that without exec signoff; otherwise we need Marcus or finance signoff for 200k.

I’ve attached a quick concession worksheet.

Ben

ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Trident PoC: concession request (200k credits, 30d extension, promo)

Marcus — quick ask for exec approval. Context and recommendation below:

Context:
- Trident AI (mid-market) is a prioritized target in Q2 for our data-inference play. They’re on track to demo live traffic after clearing the transformer bug; they’ve signaled intent to convert if we provide the extra runway.
- They’re asking: 200k tokens (free), 30d extension, 20% first-month promo tied to a 6-month conversion.

My recommendation:
- Approve 180k token top-up (compromise between AE and finance thresholds)
- Approve a 21-day extension (we can’t grant a full 30d without setting the end date to align with billing window)
- Approve a 25% discount cap is too aggressive; approve 25% only if they sign a 12-mo commit. For a 6-mo commit approve 25% only with CFO signoff; otherwise approve 25% split across usage and platform add-ons. Practically, I recommend approving 25% is not necessary — 20% is acceptable if Marcus signs off.

Conditions:
- Agreement must include an auto-convert opt-in for committed capacity or a clearly defined exit so we aren’t left with sustained heavy usage without commitment.
- CS to run a focused runbook for the next two weeks to ensure the PoC finishes on the new timeline.

Ask: Marcus — can you approve 180k tokens + 21-day extension + up to 20% promotional discount for a 6-mo commit? If yes, we’ll have legal prepare an MA addendum and marketing will create a discount code.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Team — after reviewing the ask and margin impact, I approve the following conditional concessions to accelerate the PoC close:

Approved concessions (effective immediately):
- 180,000 generation tokens credited to the Trident PoC project
- 21-day trial extension (new expiry: 2027-05-23)
- Promotional discount: 20% off the first month if Trident signs a 6-month committed contract within 30 days of PoC close

Conditions to be enforced before concession is applied:
1) Signed MA addendum covering the discount and commitment term (Legal to prepare).
2) CS to run the two-week stabilization runbook and confirm readiness to validate full-load tests.
3) Finance to record the concession in the deals tracker and apply a usage cap guardrail if run rate spikes before MA is fully executed.

Ava — please communicate the approved package to Ethan and get the MA thread launched. Ben/Marissa — coordinate Legal/Finance/CS to finalize docs today so we meet Trident’s timeline.
